sample_selection.method: Four cases per target profile selected by systematic midpoint sampling over the profile/scenario/dialogue/check sorted eligible pool. Eligibility required a revision-demanding check, observable preceding and following ego text, and no learner turn_action before the following ego response.

claim_boundary: Single-coder construct-separation diagnostic. Labels are not reliability-validated prevalence estimates and do not license replacement of the existing metric.

rows.label: reframe
rows.rationale: The tutor stops treating the learner as trapped in the old arithmetic misconception, recognizes the learner's new synthesis as evidence of readiness, and reorganizes the recommendation around deepening that insight.

rows.label: restate
rows.rationale: The revision adds empathy and humanizes the struggle count, but it preserves the same diagnosis, review target, and pedagogical move.
